title: vet-flat verified evidence
description: Part of Pea Princess (vet-flat) by Hsien Hao (Jacky) Chen - https://github.com/jacky18008/pea-princess - CC BY 4.0. The verifier's output in the role pipeline (references/pipeline.md): one verdict per evidence item, plus at most one round of things worth going back for. scripts/verify.py writes the deterministic half of this file on its own; the verifier model then reads only the items it flagged and may change a state, never invent an item. THE INTEGRATOR MAY USE NOTHING ELSE: an item that is not here, or is here as fail or unknown, is unknown in the report.

checked_at.description: When the check ran, UTC, as 2026-09-06T11:20:00Z.

items.description: One entry per evidence item, in the evidence file's order. An evidence item with no entry here has not been verified and counts as unknown.

replan.description: What is worth one more round of executor work, and nothing more. AT MOST ONE ROUND: if the second round still cannot get it, it is unknown and the report says so.

counts.description: How many items landed in each state, plus the deterministic checks that ran.

sufficiency.description: Bench only. The information-sufficiency probe: given this evidence and nothing else, is each known-good fact even derivable? Deterministic, no model, no tokens. It separates what the planner and executors failed to FETCH from what the integrator failed to USE.

state.description: pass = the quote is in the source, the source resolves, the number carries a unit, it is about the thing it claims to be, and no rule or contradiction is broken. fail = one of those is false, and `reason` says which. unknown = the executor could not get it, or the check could not be run.

reason.description: For fail and unknown: one plain sentence a reader could act on.

rules.description: The deterministic rule ids that fired, for example "quote_in_source" or "deposit_cap_branch". Empty on a pass.

checked_by.description: "verify.py" when the deterministic check settled it, or the role that changed it: "verifier". A state a model changed must say so.

item.description: The evidence item this is about, when it is about one.

ask.description: What the executor should do differently, concretely: the command with the right argument, the page to ask the user for.

round.description: Always 1. There is no second round.
